transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, my name's Kate. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi. My broadband hasn't worked since the decorators were in on Monday. Nothing at all. I'm working from home so this is really stressful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Losing the connection when you work from home is really stressful, I'm sorry. Let's see what's happening. Can I take your PIN?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. So your broadband stopped completely on Monday, the day the decorators were in. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What colour is the light on the router?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Red.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Did the decorators move anything around the phone socket, or paint over it?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: They took the socket off the wall to paint behind it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That will be it. I've run a test, and the line is broken somewhere between the master socket and the router. Wiring inside your flat isn't really our problem, you'll need to get your landlord to sort that out.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Seriously? So what am I supposed to do until then?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: In the meantime I've turned on a free unlimited data boost on your mobile so you can use it as a hotspot. Could you plug the router back in to the socket once more?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, it's plugged in.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What colour is the light now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Still red.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, so it's definitely the wiring. Can you switch on the hotspot on your phone and connect your laptop to it?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I'm connected. Work's loading.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good, so you can work through the hotspot for now. Is that okay for today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it'll do.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Have a good day.
